breadcrumb: Std 12 Geography (English) — Unit 13: Statistical Techniques — Book-back (பாடநூல் வினாக்கள்)

questions.quote: 1. The following are the monthly average rainfall of Chennai district (15.54, 10.44, 12.48, 20.96, 57.1, 41.24, 64.4, 99.28, 147.17, 204.22, 165.07, 133.76 mm). Find the mean, median and mode. (mean)

en.q: The monthly average rainfall (mm) of Chennai is 15.54, 10.44, 12.48, 20.96, 57.1, 41.24, 64.4, 99.28, 147.17, 204.22, 165.07 and 133.76. The mean monthly rainfall is about ______.

questions.quote: 1. ... Find the mean, median and mode. (median)

en.q: For the same twelve monthly rainfall values of Chennai, the median is ______.
en.explanation: In ascending order the 6th value is 57.1 and the 7th is 64.4; median = (57.1 + 64.4) / 2 = 60.75. No value repeats, so there is no mode.

ta.q: சென்னையின் அதே பன்னிரண்டு மாத மழையளவு மதிப்புகளுக்கான இடைநிலை (Median) ______.

questions.quote: 2. Calculate the mean, median and mode for the following data relating to the monthly income of workers in a factory (classes 15-25 ... 75-85; persons 6, 11, 7, 4, 4, 2, 1). (mean)

en.q: Monthly income of factory workers (thousands): classes 15-25, 25-35, 35-45, 45-55, 55-65, 65-75, 75-85 with 6, 11, 7, 4, 4, 2, 1 persons. The mean income is about ______ thousand.
en.explanation: With assumed mean A = 50, sum of fd = -36, N = 35 and i = 10: mean = 50 + (-36/35) x 10 = 39.71.

en.q: For the same income data (6, 11, 7, 4, 4, 2, 1 persons in classes 15-25 ... 75-85), the median income is about ______ thousand.
en.explanation: N/2 = 17.5 falls in the class 35-45 (cumulative frequency before it is 17): median = 35 + (0.5/7) x 10 = 35.71.

ta.q: அதே வருமானத் தரவிற்கு (15-25 முதல் 75-85 வகுப்புகளில் 6, 11, 7, 4, 4, 2, 1 நபர்கள்) இடைநிலை வருமானம் சுமார் ______ ஆயிரம்.

en.q: For the same income data, the mode (modal class 25-35 with frequency 11, f0 = 6 and f2 = 7) is about ______ thousand.

ta.q: அதே வருமானத் தரவிற்கு முகடு (முகட்டு வகுப்பு 25-35, அலைவெண் 11, f0 = 6, f2 = 7) சுமார் ______ ஆயிரம்.
